display_name: AIA — Part II Medical Report (attending doctor)

fields.label: Hospitalisation details
fields.description: If the patient was hospitalised, the details of that admission. Leave missing if not hospitalised.

fields.label: Hospital admitted to
fields.description: Name of the hospital the patient was admitted to

fields.label: Date of admission
fields.description: Date the patient was admitted (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Date of discharge
fields.description: Date the patient was discharged (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Attending doctor(s)
fields.description: Name(s) of the attending doctor(s), if stated in the notes

fields.label: Type of treatment / surgery
fields.description: Type of treatment or surgery performed

fields.label: Surgical code
fields.description: Surgical operation code, only if stated in the notes

fields.label: Name of doctor(s)
fields.description: Name of the doctor who performed the treatment or surgery

fields.label: Date of treatment
fields.description: Date the treatment or surgery was performed (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Other doctor for same condition
fields.description: Name and address of any other doctor who treated the patient for this same condition

fields.label: Date of that consultation
fields.description: Date of consultation with that other doctor (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Previous serious condition
fields.description: Diagnosis or illness the patient was previously treated for, if the notes mention any prior serious condition

fields.label: Doctor for previous condition
fields.description: Name and address of the doctor who treated that previous condition

fields.label: Date of previous diagnosis
fields.description: Date that previous condition was diagnosed (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Diagnostic test(s)
fields.description: Diagnostic tests or scans performed, e.g. CT abdomen, full blood count

fields.label: Test result(s)
fields.description: Results of those diagnostic tests or scans

fields.label: Date of test
fields.description: Date the diagnostic test was performed (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Complications prolonging healing
fields.description: Any complications that prolonged healing. Leave missing if the notes record none.

fields.label: Possibility of relapse
fields.description: Whether a relapse is possible, and the details if so. Leave missing unless the notes address it.

fields.label: Referring doctor
fields.description: Name of the doctor who referred the patient to you, if the notes mention a referral

fields.label: Referring clinic / hospital
fields.description: Name and address of the referring doctor's clinic or hospital

fields.label: Physiotherapist
fields.description: Name of the physiotherapist the patient was referred to, if any

fields.label: Physiotherapy clinic
fields.description: Name and address of the physiotherapy clinic or hospital

fields.label: Patient's regular doctor
fields.description: Name of the patient's regular doctor, if you are not their regular doctor

fields.label: Regular doctor's clinic
fields.description: Name and address of the regular doctor's clinic or hospital
